Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1792 (Somatostatin receptor type 5). Join activities to assays and target_dictionary to filter by target, and join molecule_dictionary and compound_structures to obtain molecule identifiers and canonical SMILES. Filter for standard_type IC50, standard_relation '=', and non-null pchembl_value. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to 1000 rows.
